caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornately detailed wooden cabinet with a rich brown finish, featuring a prominent grain pattern. The cabinet consists of two main sections: the upper section has two doors with arched panels and brass handles, flanked by vertical fluted columns. The top is crowned with an arched and curvilinear pediment, embellished at the center with a carved shell motif and topped on each side with sculpted human figures. The lower section includes three slanted writing surfaces, resembling drop-front desk compartments, directly above multiple drawers of varying sizes. The drawers are arranged symmetrically, each fitted with decorative brass handles. The piece stands on four cabriole legs ending in claw-and-ball feet. The overall composition is symmetrical and detailed, with a focus on wood texture and brass hardware for accents.
title: Cabinet-top Desk
